verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents Apps Script as a first-party, low-code way to automate Admin console tasks. It also documents automatic user provisioning that syncs account changes to third-party apps on its own. The evidence never shows triggers, schedules or unattended agentic runs, so background autonomy is only implied. Missing for 10: documented time- or event-based triggers for running automations unattended, evidence of general-purpose background automations beyond admin tasks and provisioning sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Anyone can use Apps Script to automate Admin console tasks in a web-based, low-code environment.
Puedes configurar el aprovisionamiento automático de usuarios para que los cambios que realices en las cuentas de usuario de Google Workspace se sincronicen automáticamente con esta app de terceros.
